wikipedia_en.testo: 1,2-Butadiene is the organic compound with the formula CH2=C=CHCH3. It is an isomer of 1,3-butadiene, which is a common monomer used to make synthetic rubber, and is often co-produced with it. It is a colorless flammable gas, one of the simplest substituted allenes.

scheda_en.intro: 1,2-Butadiene is the organic compound with the formula CH2=C=CHCH3.  It is an isomer of 1,3-butadiene, which is a common monomer used to make synthetic rubber, and is often co-produced with it.  It is a colorless flammable gas, one of the simplest substituted allenes.
scheda_en.dove:
The C4-fraction of petroleum obtained by cracking and separated by distillation consists of many compounds, predominantly (75%) 1,3-butadiene, isobutene, and 1-butene. 1,2‑Butadiene comprises less than 1% of this mixture. It is partially purified by extraction with N-methylpyrrolidone. 1,2-Butadiene has no commercial applications; US production was 4,500–23,000 tons in 2005.
